## 2. Owner-overlap table
“Same data read-only” includes a consumer of configured rules: owners use a constrained action without gaining the commissioner’s settings editor. “Same action on an owner’s behalf” is used only for the franchise-identity or roster-correction workflow, not for rule-setting pages. Approval/resolution queues are marked separately. None means no exact owner-map counterpart was found; it does not prove no owner feature exists. Label-only and related-data qualifications are explicit.
